== Ban list sources (21 October 2026) ==
The forum ban list in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86581 t=86581] (Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021120833/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t86581.html Internet Archive]) and the GEMP <code>ewok</code> list at commit ec48dc19 differ by five cards. The forum list has ''Bossk In Hound's Tooth'', ''Dengar In Punishing One'', ''Imperial Command'', ''Ralltiir Operations'' and ''Honor Of The Jedi''; GEMP does not. Both lists are on the page. The forum thread's update log says ''Honor Of The Jedi'' was added later, so the GEMP list may predate some forum updates. That is an inference and is not on the page.
